```{r setup}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()
REPO_ROOT <- if (basename(SCRIPT_DIR) == "oklahoma" &&
                  basename(dirname(SCRIPT_DIR)) == "inst") {
  normalizePath(file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..", ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
} else {
  normalizePath(SCRIPT_DIR, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}
if (file.exists(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
    requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pkgload::load_all(REPO_ROOT, quiet = TRUE, export_all = FALSE,
                    helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE)
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(ggplot2)
})

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
scalar_chr <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) < 1L) return("N/A")
  as.character(x[[1]])
}
safe_num <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(v) < 1L) return(NA_real_)
  v <- v[[1]]
  if (is.finite(v)) v else NA_real_
}
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 4) {
  x <- safe_num(x)
  if (!is.finite(x)) "N/A" else format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits, trim = TRUE)
}
fmt_t_trunc_cfg <- function(x, digits = 4) {
  tryCatch(
    PPDisentangle:::.etas_format_t_trunc_days(x, digits = digits),
    error = function(e) "none"
  )
}
fmt_ate <- function(x) {
  x <- safe_num(x)
  if (!is.finite(x)) "N/A" else sprintf("%.1f", x)
}

results_path <- trimws(Sys.getenv("OK_RESULTS_FILE", ""))
if (!nzchar(results_path)) {
  out_dir <- PPDisentangle::pp_output_path("oklahoma", repo_root = REPO_ROOT)
  candidates <- c(
    file.path(out_dir, "oklahoma_cd_current.rds"),
    file.path(out_dir, "for_paper.rds"),
    file.path(out_dir, "oklahoma_results.rds")
  )
  existing <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (!length(existing)) stop("Set OK_RESULTS_FILE or place oklahoma_cd_current.rds under output/oklahoma/")
  results_path <- existing[[1]]
}
results <- readRDS(results_path)
cfg <- results$config %||% list()
meta <- results$metadata %||% list()

prev_path <- trimws(Sys.getenv("OK_CD_PREV_RESULTS_FILE", ""))
prev <- NULL
if (nzchar(prev_path) && file.exists(prev_path)) {
  prev <- readRDS(prev_path)
}

fit_obj <- function(res, letter) {
  if (is.null(res) || is.null(res$fits_named)) return(NULL)
  res$fits_named[[letter]]
}
pick_ate <- function(ate_obj, contrast = "all_or_nothing") {
  if (is.null(ate_obj)) return(NULL)
  bc <- ate_obj$by_contrast
  if (is.list(bc) && !is.null(bc[[contrast]])) return(bc[[contrast]])
  if (!is.null(ate_obj$contrast) &&
      identical(as.character(ate_obj$contrast)[1], contrast)) {
    return(ate_obj)
  }
  if (identical(contrast, "all_or_nothing") && !is.null(ate_obj$all_nothing_sim)) {
    return(ate_obj)
  }
  NULL
}
ate_saved <- function(ate_obj, contrast = "all_or_nothing") {
  a <- pick_ate(ate_obj, contrast)
  if (is.null(a) || is.null(a$all_nothing_sim)) return(numeric())
  sim <- a$all_nothing_sim
  if ("total_saved" %in% names(sim)) return(as.numeric(sim$total_saved))
  if ("total_effect" %in% names(sim)) return(as.numeric(sim$total_effect))
  numeric()
}
ate_summary <- function(ate_obj, contrast = "all_or_nothing") {
  s <- ate_saved(ate_obj, contrast)
  s <- s[is.finite(s)]
  list(
    mean = if (length(s)) mean(s) else NA_real_,
    sd = if (length(s) > 1L) stats::sd(s) else NA_real_,
    n = length(s)
  )
}
fit_rho <- function(fit, beta_gr) {
  p <- if (!is.null(fit)) fit$params else NULL
  beta <- safe_num(beta_gr)
  if (is.null(p) || !is.finite(beta)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(
    PPDisentangle:::.etas_biv_spectral_radius(p, beta),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}
param_vec <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit) || is.null(fit$params)) return(NULL)
  p <- unlist(fit$params)
  p[is.finite(p)]
}

fit_C <- fit_obj(results, "C")
fit_D <- fit_obj(results, "D")
prev_C <- fit_obj(prev, "C")
prev_D <- fit_obj(prev, "D")
```

# Fit C / D ATEs

Positive `saved = N(control) - N(treated)` means the treatment regime saved earthquakes.

```{r tbl-ates}
ate_row <- function(letter, fit, contrast) {
  s <- ate_summary(if (!is.null(fit)) fit$ate else NULL, contrast)
  data.frame(
    Fit = letter,
    Label = scalar_chr(fit$label %||% letter),
    Contrast = contrast,
    `Mean saved` = fmt_ate(s$mean),
    `SD saved` = fmt_ate(s$sd),
    `ATE sims` = as.character(s$n),
    rho = fmt_num(fit_rho(fit, cfg$BETA_GR), 4),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
ate_df <- rbind(
  ate_row("C", fit_C, "all_or_nothing"),
  ate_row("D", fit_D, "all_or_nothing"),
  ate_row("C", fit_C, "observed"),
  ate_row("D", fit_D, "observed")
)
kable(ate_df, align = "lllllll",
      caption = "C/D ATE summaries (bivariate law).") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

# SEM relabelling diagnostics

Fit C is a naive MLE, so it has no relabelling. The traces below are Fit D (and Fit B if present).

```{r sem-relabel-helpers}
#| label: sem-relabel-helpers
#| include: false
sem_fit_obj <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  if (!is.null(fit$fit) && !is.null(fit$fit$adaptive)) return(fit$fit)
  if (!is.null(fit$sem) && !is.null(fit$sem$adaptive)) return(fit$sem)
  if (!is.null(fit$adaptive)) return(fit)
  NULL
}
get_sem_metric_trace <- function(fit) {
  sem_obj <- sem_fit_obj(fit)
  if (is.null(sem_obj) || is.null(sem_obj$adaptive)) return(NULL)
  ad <- sem_obj$adaptive
  if (!is.null(ad$metrics) && length(ad$metrics) > 0) {
    return(as.numeric(ad$metrics))
  }
  if (!is.null(ad$all_metrics) && length(ad$all_metrics) > 0) {
    vals <- vapply(ad$all_metrics, function(v) {
      if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      max(as.numeric(v), na.rm = TRUE)
    }, numeric(1))
    vals[is.infinite(vals)] <- NA_real_
    return(vals)
  }
  NULL
}
# Drop the left prefix of scale-breaking SEM jumps (C-lock / MAP teleport)
# so later variation is visible. Keep original iteration indices.
sem_first_kept_iter <- function(y, frac = 0.10, range_keep = 0.25,
                                min_keep = 8L, early_frac = 0.2) {
  y <- as.numeric(y)
  n <- length(y)
  if (n < 3L) return(1L)
  finite <- is.finite(y)
  if (sum(finite) < 3L) return(1L)
  span <- diff(range(y[finite], na.rm = TRUE))
  final <- y[max(which(finite))]
  thresh <- if (is.finite(span) && span > 0) frac * span else Inf
  min_keep <- min(as.integer(min_keep), n)
  max_drop <- n - min_keep
  i <- 1L
  early_n <- max(2L, min(n - min_keep, ceiling(early_frac * n)))
  if (is.finite(thresh) && early_n >= 1L) {
    early_idx <- seq_len(early_n)
    early_idx <- early_idx[is.finite(y[early_idx])]
    if (length(early_idx)) {
      worst <- early_idx[which.max(abs(y[early_idx] - final))]
      if (abs(y[worst] - final) > thresh) i <- max(i, as.integer(worst) + 1L)
    }
  }
  i <- min(i, max_drop + 1L)
  while (i <= max_drop) {
    if (!is.finite(y[i])) { i <- i + 1L; next }
    if (is.finite(thresh) && abs(y[i] - final) > thresh) { i <- i + 1L; next }
    break
  }
  while (i <= max_drop) {
    rest <- y[i:n]
    rest <- rest[is.finite(rest)]
    rest2 <- y[(i + 1L):n]
    rest2 <- rest2[is.finite(rest2)]
    if (length(rest) < 2L || length(rest2) < 1L) break
    r1 <- diff(range(rest))
    r2 <- diff(range(rest2))
    if (is.finite(r1) && r1 > 0 && is.finite(r2) && (r2 / r1) < range_keep) {
      i <- i + 1L
      next
    }
    break
  }
  as.integer(i)
}

drop_sem_scale_prefix <- function(df, value_col, iter_col = "Iteration",
                                  group_cols = NULL) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) < 1L) return(df)
  if (!value_col %in% names(df) || !iter_col %in% names(df)) return(df)
  if (is.null(group_cols)) {
    group_cols <- intersect(c("Model", "Metric", "entry"), names(df))
  }
  group_cols <- intersect(group_cols, names(df))
  split_keys <- if (length(group_cols)) {
    interaction(df[group_cols], drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)
  } else {
    rep("all", nrow(df))
  }
  parts <- split(df, split_keys, drop = TRUE)
  out <- lapply(parts, function(d) {
    d <- d[order(as.numeric(d[[iter_col]])), , drop = FALSE]
    keep_from <- sem_first_kept_iter(d[[value_col]])
    if (keep_from > 1L && keep_from <= nrow(d)) {
      d <- d[seq.int(keep_from, nrow(d)), , drop = FALSE]
    }
    d
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

get_sem_proposal_trace <- function(fit) {
  sem_obj <- sem_fit_obj(fit)
  if (is.null(sem_obj) || is.null(sem_obj$adaptive$all_metrics)) return(NULL)
  am <- sem_obj$adaptive$all_metrics
  rows <- lapply(seq_along(am), function(i) {
    v <- as.numeric(am[[i]])
    if (!length(v)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(Iteration = i, Proposal = seq_along(v), LogLik = v)
  })
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
  if (!length(rows)) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
extract_selected_confusion_trace <- function(sem_obj, model_label) {
  ad <- if (!is.null(sem_obj$adaptive)) sem_obj$adaptive else sem_obj$fit$adaptive
  if (is.null(ad) || is.null(ad$class_results) || is.null(ad$all_metrics)) return(NULL)
  if (length(ad$class_results) < 1 || length(ad$all_metrics) < 1) return(NULL)
  offset <- 0L
  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(ad$all_metrics)) {
    metric_i <- ad$all_metrics[[i]]
    n_i <- length(metric_i)
    if (n_i < 1L) next
    best_j <- which.max(as.numeric(metric_i))
    class_idx <- offset + best_j
    if (class_idx > length(ad$class_results)) break
    cm <- ad$class_results[[class_idx]]
    if (is.null(cm)) {
      offset <- offset + n_i
      next
    }
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      iteration = i,
      Model = model_label,
      control_as_control = as.numeric(cm$control_as_control %||% 0),
      control_as_treated = as.numeric(cm$control_as_treated %||% 0),
      treated_as_control = as.numeric(cm$treated_as_control %||% 0),
      treated_as_treated = as.numeric(cm$treated_as_treated %||% 0)
    )
    offset <- offset + n_i
  }
  if (length(rows) < 1L) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
build_cm <- function(sem_obj) {
  if (is.null(sem_obj) || is.null(sem_obj$adaptive$adaptive_labelling)) return(NULL)
  lab <- sem_obj$adaptive$adaptive_labelling
  post <- lab[lab$t >= 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (is.null(post$location_process) || is.null(post$inferred_process)) return(NULL)
  tab <- table(Location = post$location_process, Inferred = post$inferred_process)
  as.data.frame.matrix(tab)
}
fit_B <- fit_obj(results, "B")
sem_specs <- list(
  list(fit = fit_B, lab = "B: SEM Biv"),
  list(fit = fit_D, lab = "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)")
)
```

```{r tbl-cm-summary}
#| label: tbl-cm-summary
sum_rows <- list()
for (info in sem_specs) {
  cm <- build_cm(sem_fit_obj(info$fit))
  if (is.null(cm)) next
  n_total <- sum(cm)
  ctrl_to_treat <- if ("treated" %in% colnames(cm) && "control" %in% rownames(cm)) {
    cm["control", "treated"]
  } else {
    0
  }
  treat_to_ctrl <- if ("control" %in% colnames(cm) && "treated" %in% rownames(cm)) {
    cm["treated", "control"]
  } else {
    0
  }
  n_flipped <- ctrl_to_treat + treat_to_ctrl
  sum_rows[[length(sum_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    Model = info$lab,
    `Post events` = n_total,
    `Ctrl to Treat` = ctrl_to_treat,
    `Treat to Ctrl` = treat_to_ctrl,
    `Total relabelled` = n_flipped,
    `Pct relabelled` = paste0(round(n_flipped / n_total * 100, 1), "%"),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
if (length(sum_rows) > 0) {
  kable(do.call(rbind, sum_rows),
        caption = "SEM relabelling summary on post-treatment events (location vs inferred process).",
        align = "lccccc") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No SEM relabelling summaries available (Fit D SEM object missing or has no adaptive_labelling).\n")
}
```

```{r fig-sem-confusion}
#| label: fig-sem-confusion
#| fig-cap: "Accepted SEM confusion-matrix entry counts by inner iteration. The initial scale-breaking MAP/C-lock jump is omitted so later 1-count changes are visible; each entry has its own y-scale."
#| fig-height: 8
trace_rows <- list()
for (info in sem_specs) {
  sem_obj <- sem_fit_obj(info$fit)
  if (is.null(sem_obj) || is.null(sem_obj$adaptive)) next
  trace_df <- extract_selected_confusion_trace(sem_obj, info$lab)
  if (!is.null(trace_df) && nrow(trace_df) > 0) {
    trace_rows[[length(trace_rows) + 1L]] <- trace_df
  }
}
if (length(trace_rows) > 0) {
  trace_df <- do.call(rbind, trace_rows)
  trace_long <- reshape2::melt(
    trace_df,
    id.vars = c("iteration", "Model"),
    measure.vars = c(
      "control_as_control", "control_as_treated",
      "treated_as_control", "treated_as_treated"
    ),
    variable.name = "entry",
    value.name = "count"
  )
  trace_long$entry <- factor(
    as.character(trace_long$entry),
    levels = c("control_as_control", "control_as_treated", "treated_as_control", "treated_as_treated"),
    labels = c("Control -> Control", "Control -> Treated", "Treated -> Control", "Treated -> Treated")
  )
  trace_long <- drop_sem_scale_prefix(trace_long, value_col = "count", iter_col = "iteration")
}
if (length(trace_rows) > 0 && !is.null(trace_long) && nrow(trace_long) > 0) {
  ggplot(trace_long, aes(x = iteration, y = count, colour = entry)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_grid(entry ~ Model, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Confusion entry", values = c(
      "Control -> Control" = "#1f78b4",
      "Control -> Treated" = "#e31a1c",
      "Treated -> Control" = "#ff7f00",
      "Treated -> Treated" = "#33a02c"
    )) +
    labs(x = "Iteration", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
} else {
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, "No SEM confusion-matrix trace found.")
}
```

```{r fig-sem-adaptive-loglik}
#| label: fig-sem-adaptive-loglik
#| fig-cap: "Adaptive SEM selected-proposal score (solid) after omitting the initial scale-breaking MAP/C-lock jump. Grey points are other proposals in the same zoom window. Running best is dashed."
#| fig-height: 4.5
sem_metric_rows <- list()
sem_prop_rows <- list()
for (info in sem_specs) {
  tr <- get_sem_metric_trace(info$fit)
  if (!is.null(tr) && length(tr) > 0) {
    sem_metric_rows[[length(sem_metric_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Iteration = seq_along(tr),
      LogLik = as.numeric(tr),
      Model = info$lab
    )
  }
  pr <- get_sem_proposal_trace(info$fit)
  if (!is.null(pr) && nrow(pr) > 0) {
    pr$Model <- info$lab
    sem_prop_rows[[length(sem_prop_rows) + 1]] <- pr
  }
}
if (length(sem_metric_rows) > 0) {
  sem_metric_df <- do.call(rbind, sem_metric_rows)
  sem_metric_df <- sem_metric_df[is.finite(sem_metric_df$LogLik), , drop = FALSE]
  sem_metric_df <- drop_sem_scale_prefix(sem_metric_df, value_col = "LogLik")
}
if (length(sem_metric_rows) > 0 && !is.null(sem_metric_df) && nrow(sem_metric_df) > 0) {
  sem_metric_df$RunningBest <- ave(sem_metric_df$LogLik, sem_metric_df$Model, FUN = cummax)
  last_idx <- !duplicated(sem_metric_df$Model, fromLast = TRUE)
  sem_metric_last <- sem_metric_df[last_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  sem_metric_last$lbl <- sprintf("final = %.2f", sem_metric_last$LogLik)
  sem_prop_zoom <- NULL
  if (length(sem_prop_rows) > 0) {
    sem_prop_df <- do.call(rbind, sem_prop_rows)
    kept <- unique(sem_metric_df[, c("Model", "Iteration")])
    sem_prop_df <- merge(sem_prop_df, kept, by = c("Model", "Iteration"))
    lims <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(sem_metric_df, sem_metric_df$Model, drop = TRUE), function(d) {
      ymin <- min(d$LogLik, na.rm = TRUE)
      ymax <- max(d$LogLik, na.rm = TRUE)
      pad <- max(0.08 * (ymax - ymin), 0.2)
      data.frame(Model = d$Model[[1]], ymin = ymin - pad, ymax = ymax + pad)
    }))
    sem_prop_df <- merge(sem_prop_df, lims, by = "Model")
    sem_prop_zoom <- sem_prop_df[
      is.finite(sem_prop_df$LogLik) &
        sem_prop_df$LogLik >= sem_prop_df$ymin &
        sem_prop_df$LogLik <= sem_prop_df$ymax,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
  }
  p_ll <- ggplot(sem_metric_df, aes(x = Iteration, y = LogLik, colour = Model))
  if (!is.null(sem_prop_zoom) && nrow(sem_prop_zoom) > 0) {
    p_ll <- p_ll + geom_point(
      data = sem_prop_zoom,
      aes(x = Iteration, y = LogLik),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.18, size = 0.55, colour = "grey30"
    )
  }
  p_ll +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_line(aes(y = RunningBest), linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      data = sem_metric_last,
      aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = lbl),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2, colour = "black"
    ) +
    labs(x = "Adaptive SEM iteration", y = "Selected SEM score / running best") +
    facet_wrap(~Model, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
} else {
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, "No adaptive SEM score trace found.")
}
```

```{r fig-sem-cumulative-flips}
#| label: fig-sem-cumulative-flips
#| fig-cap: "Per-iteration SEM label flips after omitting the initial MAP Hamming spike. Average and accepted flips have separate y-scales so later 0–2 flip noise is visible."
#| fig-height: 6
flip_rows <- list()
for (info in sem_specs) {
  sem_obj <- sem_fit_obj(info$fit)
  ad <- if (!is.null(sem_obj)) sem_obj$adaptive else NULL
  if (is.null(ad) || is.null(ad$average_flips) || is.null(ad$max_metric_flips)) next
  n <- min(length(ad$average_flips), length(ad$max_metric_flips))
  if (n < 1) next
  flip_rows[[length(flip_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Iteration = seq_len(n),
    Model = info$lab,
    AverageFlips = as.numeric(ad$average_flips[seq_len(n)]),
    AcceptedFlips = as.numeric(ad$max_metric_flips[seq_len(n)])
  )
}
if (length(flip_rows) > 0) {
  flip_df <- do.call(rbind, flip_rows)
  flip_long <- reshape2::melt(
    flip_df,
    id.vars = c("Iteration", "Model"),
    measure.vars = c("AverageFlips", "AcceptedFlips"),
    variable.name = "Metric",
    value.name = "Flips"
  )
  flip_long$Metric <- factor(
    as.character(flip_long$Metric),
    levels = c("AverageFlips", "AcceptedFlips"),
    labels = c("Average flips", "Accepted flips")
  )
  flip_long <- drop_sem_scale_prefix(flip_long, value_col = "Flips")
}
if (length(flip_rows) > 0 && !is.null(flip_long) && nrow(flip_long) > 0) {
  ggplot(flip_long, aes(x = Iteration, y = Flips, colour = Metric)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_grid(Metric ~ Model, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "Average flips" = "#08519c",
      "Accepted flips" = "#a50f15"
    )) +
    labs(x = "Adaptive SEM iteration", y = "Flips per iteration") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
} else {
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, "No SEM flip traces found.")
}
```

```{r tbl-final-loglik-compare}
#| label: tbl-final-loglik-compare
final_ll_rows <- list()
for (info in sem_specs) {
  tr <- as.numeric(get_sem_metric_trace(info$fit))
  tr <- tr[is.finite(tr)]
  if (length(tr) > 0) {
    final_ll_rows[[length(final_ll_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Model = info$lab,
      Iterations = length(tr),
      Final_Objective = round(tail(tr, 1), 2),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}
if (length(final_ll_rows) > 0) {
  kable(do.call(rbind, final_ll_rows), align = "lrc",
        caption = "Final selected objective from the adaptive relabelling trace (higher is better).") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
}
```

# Diff vs previous (if provided)

```{r tbl-diff}
#| label: tbl-diff
if (is.null(prev)) {
  cat("No previous C/D RDS set (`OK_CD_PREV_RESULTS_FILE`). Re-run via `launch_oklahoma_cd_update_nesi.sh` to populate diffs.\n")
} else {
  prev_cfg <- prev$config %||% list()
  diff_settings <- data.frame(
    Setting = c("SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS", "SEM_INNER_ITER", "SEM_OUTER_MAXIT_BIV", "ATE_N_SIMS", "BETA_GR"),
    Previous = c(
      fmt_t_trunc_cfg(prev_cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS),
      scalar_chr(prev_cfg$SEM_INNER_ITER %||% prev_cfg$SEM_INNER),
      scalar_chr(prev_cfg$SEM_OUTER_MAXIT_BIV),
      scalar_chr(prev_cfg$ATE_N_SIMS),
      fmt_num(prev_cfg$BETA_GR, 6)
    ),
    Current = c(
      fmt_t_trunc_cfg(cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS),
      scalar_chr(cfg$SEM_INNER_ITER %||% cfg$SEM_INNER),
      scalar_chr(cfg$SEM_OUTER_MAXIT_BIV),
      scalar_chr(cfg$ATE_N_SIMS),
      fmt_num(cfg$BETA_GR, 6)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  kable(diff_settings, align = "lrr",
        caption = "Settings: previous vs current.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

  ate_diff_row <- function(letter, cur_fit, prev_fit, contrast) {
    cur <- ate_summary(if (!is.null(cur_fit)) cur_fit$ate else NULL, contrast)
    old <- ate_summary(if (!is.null(prev_fit)) prev_fit$ate else NULL, contrast)
    data.frame(
      Fit = letter,
      Contrast = contrast,
      `ATE prev` = fmt_ate(old$mean),
      `ATE curr` = fmt_ate(cur$mean),
      `Delta (curr-prev)` = fmt_ate(cur$mean - old$mean),
      `rho prev` = fmt_num(fit_rho(prev_fit, prev_cfg$BETA_GR), 4),
      `rho curr` = fmt_num(fit_rho(cur_fit, cfg$BETA_GR), 4),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  ate_diff <- rbind(
    ate_diff_row("C", fit_C, prev_C, "all_or_nothing"),
    ate_diff_row("D", fit_D, prev_D, "all_or_nothing"),
    ate_diff_row("C", fit_C, prev_C, "observed"),
    ate_diff_row("D", fit_D, prev_D, "observed")
  )
  kable(ate_diff, align = "llrrrrr",
        caption = "ATE / spectral radius: previous vs current.") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

  pc0 <- param_vec(prev_C)
  pd0 <- param_vec(prev_D)
  nms2 <- unique(c(names(pc), names(pd), names(pc0), names(pd0)))
  nms2 <- c(intersect(param_order, nms2), setdiff(nms2, param_order))
  param_diff <- data.frame(
    Parameter = nms2,
    `C prev` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) fmt_num(pc0[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
    `C curr` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) fmt_num(pc[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
    `C delta` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) {
      a <- safe_num(pc0[[nm]]); b <- safe_num(pc[[nm]])
      if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b)) "N/A" else fmt_num(b - a, 5)
    }, character(1)),
    `D prev` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) fmt_num(pd0[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
    `D curr` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) fmt_num(pd[[nm]], 5), character(1)),
    `D delta` = vapply(nms2, function(nm) {
      a <- safe_num(pd0[[nm]]); b <- safe_num(pd[[nm]])
      if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b)) "N/A" else fmt_num(b - a, 5)
    }, character(1)),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  kable(param_diff, align = "lrrrrrr",
        caption = "Parameter deltas (current − previous).") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
}
```
